key_insight: MEGA-CL is a graph-based foundation model that combines contrastive learning and external attention to improve generalizable ADMET prediction across many molecular tasks.
clinical_relevance: It could help prioritize safer, more drug-like candidates earlier by giving more reliable in silico estimates of key ADMET properties such as clearance and distribution.
method: Self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust molecular representations
Multi-head external attention to capture global inter-graph relationships
Enhanced message passing to model local substructures while reducing over-smoothing
evidence_signal: The model was benchmarked on 13 datasets and 21 ADMET tasks, and external/prospective tests reported strong agreement, including >75% of predictions within 3-fold error and 73.3% correct CYP450 inhibition classification.
watch_item: Promising performance still needs careful validation for new chemical spaces and real-world deployment, since ADMET prediction quality can vary by assay, endpoint, and dataset shift.
paper_title: MEGA-CL: A Molecular Foundation Model for Generalizable ADMET Prediction through Graph External Attention and Contrastive Learning
